claims.text: Seoul’s account describes Joseon court institutions; NIKH describes Gojong’s 1897 imperial transition. Busan’s accounts distinguish Dongnae’s foreign-affairs role and the 1883 gamri office amid coerced opening. A shared dynasty name does not establish identical court and port institutions, uninterrupted local powers or consent. Korean material is working paraphrase, not original-instrument collation.
